query:
SELECT lf.contaSistema, lf.setor, SUM(CAST(lf.valor AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as total, COUNT(*) as qtd
FROM lancamento_fluxo lf
WHERE lf.periodoCustoId = 60001
GROUP BY lf.contaSistema, lf.setor
ORDER BY total DESC
